name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key. Created by AI under the directions of the maintainer.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.247: Status lines name the state only, not the row's own name a second time. "SubDL API ... API
    reachable" read as doppelt gemoppelt on a phone; it now says "reachable", and the login row says "OK"
    instead of "Login OK" - same for the failure lines ("wrong username/password" instead of "Login
    failed: wrong username/password"). Statements about the API KEY keep their wording: the key is a
    different subject than the endpoint.
